mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, increasing esomeprazole plasma concentrations and prolonging acid suppression; both agents may increase gastric pH affecting absorption of other drugs.
action: Monitor for esomeprazole adverse effects (headache, GI effects); consider dose reduction or alternative antibiotic if excessive acid suppression occurs; ensure adequate spacing with pH-dependent drugs.
